title: How Mangalya works
intro: Two minutes, and everyone in the family knows how this works.

story.title: Mangalya is for the whole family
story.body: One search, done together. A profile can be made by the person, or by a mother, father, brother, sister, grandparent or guardian on their behalf.

story.title: First, whose search is it?
story.body: You choose: myself, my son, my daughter, or someone else in the family. Everything after that is about that person, and Mangalya shows brides or grooms accordingly.

story.title: Your Home Circle
story.body: Add the family members who help — by name or mobile number. They search with you and can answer requests. Each person’s role stays clear: who is the candidate, who is the parent.

story.title: Requests, accepted by both sides
story.body: You send a request; the other family sees it. Names, contact details and the full profile are shared only after both sides accept.

story.title: Matches work both ways
story.body: Describe the partner you hope for in your own words. Mangalya shows people who fit your wishes and whose wishes you fit. Someone who asked for a different age or place will not appear.

story.title: Chats that suit each person
story.body: The two candidates get a private chat that keeps nothing. Parents and relatives chat normally, like on WhatsApp. A chat for both families together is optional.

story.title: A marriage agent, if you want one
story.body: Trusted bureaus on Mangalya can search for you and bring families who are not on the app. You choose the agent; they never see your contact until you allow it.

faq.a: The person themselves, or any family member for them. The person takes it over when they sign in with their own mobile number.

faq.q: Why a selfie check when I set up someone else’s profile?
faq.a: So every profile on Mangalya is made by a real, known person. It takes a minute; the picture is not kept.

faq.q: Why am I not shown to anyone?
faq.a: A profile appears in search once it has education, work, marital status and relocation. The wizard asks these; you can change them on My profile.

faq.q: Why don’t I see some people?
faq.a: Mangalya only shows brides to those looking for a bride, grooms to those looking for a groom, and never someone whose own age or place preference leaves you out.

faq.q: How do I add my family?
faq.a: Open Circle, type their name or mobile number, choose how they are related, and send. They join once they accept.
The candidate, or any parent or guardian in their Home Circle. Whoever answers first answers for the family.
The candidates’ chat is deleted when it ends. Family chats are kept, like any messenger, and only the two people in them can read them. Screenshots are blocked across Mangalya.
Open Marriage agents, read their record, and choose one. They see your search and share profiles with you; you decide on every proposal.
